• A search for fractional charge particles produced in neutrino interactions has been performed using a 23 ton avalanche chamber.

(1) we searched for free quarks in neutrino and antinuetrino interactions, and (2) we found one candidate event for a quark with a fractional charge of +1/3, and (3) the probability of this candidate being an instrumental effect is small.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the search for free quark production by neutrinos.
the search for free quark events liberated via neutrino quark coupling using the largest possible available energy.
the search for free quark production in the neutrino interactions with the highest possible energy available at CERN.
